jobs.name: 拂云露额
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a nine-layer Chinese cultivation character portrait. Reference 1 is a cropped hair MATERIAL sample only, reference 2 is our bald head for proportions. Do NOT recreate the silhouette of reference 1; design the specified NEW hairstyle. References are OUR OWN existing art: use exactly its warm charcoal black hair, restrained warm grey fibre highlights, fine matte ink-wash strand rendering, hand-painted detail density, calm lighting, no gloss. NOT photorealistic, not anime flat shading. Strict orthographic FRONT view, level camera, centred head axis, no yaw, no tilted skull. Compact natural crown (no tall dome or flattened wide cap), realistic width and hairline. ONLY draw the requested isolated HAIR layer on real TRANSPARENT alpha, crisp fine transparent flyaways, no background, shadow, glow, paper rectangle, face, skin, ears, eyebrows, eyes, nose, mouth, neck, clothes or mannequin. The haircut can naturally overlap ear positions, never carve ear-shaped outlines or holes.
Subject: Female practical cultivator: swept backward hair with subtle central division and a soft low natural hairline, close-fitting temple hair, two delicate SHORT wisps ending near upper cheek, clear open forehead, no long chest locks.
Layer ownership: FRONT hair includes only front scalp cap, hairline, short temples and any specified cheek-facing locks. Interior below hairline must be transparent. Absolutely exclude back hair, ponytail, rear buns and back-of-body hanging hair. Place compact cap in upper-middle of a portrait canvas, with ample padding. Hairline and temples remain frontal and fit the reference face proportions.

Subject: High tied slender ponytail behind head, small compact wrapped tie above back crown, smooth flowing tail falling behind neck and shoulders to upper back, no broad fan shape, no ribbons.
